title: ADR-SSA: An Enhanced Sparrow Search Algorithm for Complex Optimization and Data-Driven Forecasting (Execution Code)
description:
MATLAB execution code accompanying the manuscript "ADR-SSA: An Enhanced Sparrow Search Algorithm for Complex Optimization and Data-Driven Forecasting". ADR-SSA enhances the Sparrow Search Algorithm with two coordinated mechanisms: dynamic reverse learning, which repositions the worst-performing individuals relative to the evolving search region, and adaptive t-distribution mutation, which perturbs elite individuals with a scale that adapts during iteration.

Contents: the ADR-SSA implementation (code/ADR_SSA.m); CEC2022 comparison and component-ablation scripts (Ablation.m, CEC2022_DRL_ATM_ExcelOnly.m); constrained engineering design experiments on the welded beam and pressure vessel problems with seven optimizers (engineering.m, plot_engineering.m); convergence-curve plotting for the forecasting experiments (machine.m); population diversity / exploration-exploitation analysis (Dive_Explor_Exploit.m); the compiled CEC2022 benchmark suite for Windows x64 (cec22_func.mexw64); and utility functions for initialization and Levy flights.

Requirements: MATLAB (R2020a or later), Statistics and Machine Learning Toolbox, and Microsoft Windows x64 for the bundled benchmark MEX file. Comparison optimizers and the CEC2022 toolbox sources are third-party and are not redistributed; see the repository README for the list of files to add before running the experiments.
